generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers, unique per table, never NULL; drawn once before any child FK is drawn and never re-sampled or dropped. If appending to compact rows, start above the maximum compact PK.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy from the generated parent PK pool (inst[parent][pk]); nullable FKs get at most one NULL row per instance; for parent-side unmatched_join_rows targets leave >=1 parent PK out of the child FK draw so a parent row has no child; NEVER plant a child FK value outside the parent PK pool.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Sample from the enum pool of the referenced table; exact case as listed; never store query literals (e.g. lowercase variants) or rank integers in the column.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Short descriptive phrases; 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns; near-variants of listed literals; recompute and adjust the achieved share after all planting.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Uniform dates in 1970-01-01..2013-12-31 23:59:59, format %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S (zero-padded); 20-50% duplicate share; adjust after duplicate planting; every emitted value must parse under %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_amount: Decimal string with 2-3 fractional digits, >= 0; used for Accounts.Account_Details.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: Boundary literals are query literals, not stored column values; do not plant them into enum or PK columns. For non-enum columns add the literal, one step below and one step above (numbers by step, dates by one day).
generic_sampling_rules.tie: Ties are realized by making >=2 rows share an existing value from the column pool (repeated enum value, repeated FK, repeated rank); never write the rank integer into a CHAR/FK column.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Nullable columns: at least one NULL row and at least one non-NULL row per instance; exactly the compact share where stated; NOT NULL columns never NULL; a planted NULL is never replaced to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.compose_planting: Compute one value list per column satisfying all applicable targets in a single pass; do not let later planting steps overwrite earlier ones on the same column.
generic_sampling_rules.fk_integrity: All generated FK values must belong to the parent PK value set (only exception nullable-FK NULLs). Unmatched-join targets are satisfied exclusively via parent_rows_without_children. Writers must enable foreign_keys=ON during insert or validate row FK membership before insert; each instance must end with new_fk_violations == 0.
generic_sampling_rules.size_semantics: table_sizes_per_instance is the FINAL table size per instance; generated rows = spec_size - compact_size (min 0); compact rows are copied unchanged first and never deleted.
generic_sampling_rules.post_validation: After all planting verify and REPORT (do not drop rows): FK membership against parent PK set, group sizes (1,2,>=3), aggregate boundary counts, duplicate shares (20-50%), NULL rule per nullable column, date format/range, and tie ranks. Failures must be surfaced in the CLI summary.
